elaine: kicking this off — canary -> 10% traffic, smoke tests queued. I pushed the runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/staging-deploy
sam: noted, I'll watch the smoke jobs and metrics (latency, 99th, memory). tagging @mike-oncall for infra checks.
jordan: smoke tests: first 3 checks passed. failing check: reranker integration timeout (500ms -> 3s) on instance runner-3, retrying. snippet: ```curl -sS http://staging-health.local/health | jq .status```
mike-oncall: saw the spike, looking at GC and logs on runner-3. also bumping connection pool to 200 for test. will report within 5m.
sam: canary metrics so far: p50 ~ 45ms, p95 ~ 180ms, error rate 0.2% (mostly 503 from reranker). holding canary until reranker retries complete. :eyes:
jordan: reranker timeout seems intermittent, increasing retry helped, second smoke run green. logs: "WARN reranker: transient timeout, retry succeeded"
deploy-bot: Canary complete · tag=release-rc5 · canary_traffic=10% -> 50% · status=ok · checks_passed=smoke,integrations,connectivity · duration=18m
elaine: shifting to 100% for staging if everyone is happy. also adding a soft-pin on tag for 1h for post-deploy metrics.
mike-oncall: +1 on shifting. I'll keep an eye on runner-3; created ticket INF-482 for follow-up.
release-manager: pinning release-rc5 to staging until 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z for post-deploy verification. if no regression, we'll proceed with prod cut.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy COMPLETED · env=staging · tag=release-rc5 · commit=abc123def4 · result=success · rollout=100% · duration_total=25m32s · artifacts=https://artifacts.redwood/release-rc5 · monitor_links=[https://monitoring.redwood/staging/release-rc5] :white_check_mark:
elaine: nice! running final quick smoke and perf sanity. will call for prod in ~45m if metrics stable.
sam: quick note — memory on runner-3 peaked +30% for ~2 min during canary then returned to baseline. not blocking, but watch.
jordan: leaving small postmortem note in the deploy thread for the reranker transient: probable upstream timeout; will add warmup and adjust client timeout from 500ms->1200ms in next patch.
mike-oncall: thanks — I'll correlate with infra autoscale events.
release-manager: summary for release notes: rc5, minor reranker retry improvement, infra ticket INF-482 opened, pin until 22:00Z, deploy duration ~25m. adding to release checklist. :memo:
elaine: thanks everyone. I'll post an update in #general after the prod cut. :tada:
